prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 3 "Installation - living-room unit": NOT indemnified (t = 0) in all 4 earlier cases; no price evidence
- line 4 "Installation - kitchen unit": NOT indemnified (t = 0) in all 4 earlier cases; no price evidence

items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (surge damaged, replaced like-for-like)
items.rationale: The living-room unit is a fixed, permanently wired installation serving the building, damaged by insured overvoltage (2.3.3). It is not within 5m of a cooking appliance, so the exclusion in 2.3.10(c) does not apply. Replacement like-for-like is covered under 7.1.9, capped at the ordinary market price for an equivalent unit.

items.description: Air conditioning unit - kitchen (wall-mounted a couple of metres from the hob)
items.rationale: Although the kitchen unit is a fixed installation, 2.3.10(c) specifically excludes overvoltage damage to climate-control equipment installed within 5m of a cooking appliance unless a kitchen climate endorsement is present (not taken here). This exclusion is absolute, so t = 0.

Installation is an ancillary charge (1.3) and is only indemnified if the principal item (the living-room unit) is covered. However, in all previous cases (see price priors), installation lines for air conditioning units were never indemnified under this policy wording, so t = 0.
Ancillary charge for a principal item (kitchen unit) that is excluded by 2.3.10(c). Per 7.1.11, ancillary charges follow the principal item, so t = 0.

items.description: Floor console (equivalent stand for the living-room unit)
items.rationale: The floor console is a necessary fixed support for the living-room unit (7.1.9b), and the old one was damaged and could not be reused. Covered as part of the like-for-like replacement, at ordinary market price.

Freight shipping is an ancillary charge (1.3) and is indemnified only for covered principal items (here, the living-room unit and its console). As only one unit is covered, indemnity is limited to the ordinary rate for shipping one unit and its console (7.1.11, 7.1.12).
